title: [spec-gap][R-CCP12-003/009/016] Rust select_channel_with_gnss diverges: no density fallback, no CCP-9 announce priority, u8 epoch
description: Sweep docs/spec-coverage/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md. rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs:165-201 select_channel_with_gnss: (1) no density>10→CH0 fallback (spec §3.1 step 1/§3.3 'all nodes fall back to CH0'); python implements it (channel_plan.py:295-296, tested test_ccp.py:107). (2) no announce-driven CCP-9 priority (spec §5): python link/channel.py:113-119 honors peer rx_channel (tested test_channel.py:217-278); rust only sets its own advertised rx_channel (lichen-node/src/scheduler.rs:189-195) and ignores peers'. (3) epoch param is u8 (lib.rs:169,188) while the TDMA beacon wire epoch is u32 BE (tdma_beacon.rs:6,42) and python/C use u32 — different channel vs other stacks for epochs>255. (4) no production callers (lib.rs unit tests only) — cheap to fix before wiring. Suggested placement: rust/lichen-core select_channel_with_gnss signature+body and lichen-node call sites; resolve chain order with the priority-chain bead first.
